name: Talking Doll

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A doll that repeats up to six short phrases it was taught.
text: While this stuffed doll is within 5 feet of you, you can spend a Short Rest telling it to say up to six phrases, none of which can be more than six words long, and set a condition under which the doll speaks each phrase. (No other effect in the game.)
